title: Make link-draft CoAP example a valid dispatched payload
description: Correctness review found draft-lichen-link-01 §6.2 shows PLD=<1 byte SCHC-compressed CoAP>, contradicting §3.1/LICHEN framing: authenticated PLD begins with dispatch 0x14 and the body begins with a SCHC Rule ID, so any defined SCHC payload is at least 2 bytes (and a real CoAP residue is larger). Replace the placeholder with an explicit dispatch+valid SCHC packet and recalculate LENGTH; coordinate with project-LICHEN-worker6-2wi1 rather than merely changing old 0x3D to the still-invalid 1-byte arithmetic.
